title: QA 01 - Mercury - Book catalog CSV
message: QA — Book catalog export. Open https://books.toscrape.com/ in your computer. Collect the first 6 books displayed on its home page: title, price and stock status. Save them to a CSV in this chat, read the saved file back to verify 6 unique rows and the actual prices, and give me the download link. Complete it end to end. Do not buy anything or contact anyone.

title: QA 02 - Luna - Invoice reconciliation
message: QA — Invoice reconciliation. These are synthetic invoices: INV-101 North Studio $120 unpaid; INV-102 Cedar Lab $80 paid; INV-103 North Studio $45 unpaid; INV-101 North Studio $120 unpaid (duplicate); INV-104 River Co $210 unpaid; INV-105 Cedar Lab $30 paid. Deduplicate by invoice ID, create invoices.csv and unpaid-summary.md in this chat, calculate the unpaid total and unpaid totals per customer, then read both saved files back and provide working download links. Do not send messages or touch the real CRM.

title: QA 03 - Mercury - Two-source research
message: QA — Two-source research. Use your computer to read https://example.com and https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains . Explain what example domains are for, whether I can register example.com, and whether I should depend on its HTTP service in a production app. Save a concise example-domains.md with links to the actual sources, read it back and give me its download link. Do not answer from memory or register anything.

title: QA 04 - Mercury - Model and capability advice
message: QA — Model and capability awareness. Check your actual available model catalog and tools. For repetitive website-to-CSV work compare Mercury 2.5, GPT Luna and Claude Sonnet 4.6: current input/output prices, image abilities, and which you would start with to keep cost down. Estimate each model cost for 1 million uncached input tokens plus 10,000 output tokens, clearly separating that from an actual workflow quote. Can Mercury use a vision helper in this system? Inspect current capabilities and explain the actual route. Do not change my settings or use an expensive model to answer.

title: QA 05 - Luna - Onboarding documents
message: QA — Onboarding checklist. Make a 3-day onboarding plan for a fictional bakery assistant from these requirements: Day 1 safety briefing and equipment tour; Day 2 inventory practice and shadowing; Day 3 supervised opening checklist and feedback. Save onboarding.md and onboarding.json in this chat. JSON needs days 1, 2, 3 and a tasks array for each. Read both files back, check that all six requested items are present once, and give the download links. No external apps, real employee records or messages.

title: QA 06 - Mercury - Dropdown interaction
message: QA — Dropdown interaction. Open https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/dropdown in your computer. Select Option 2 and verify the selected value. Then select Option 1 and verify the final selected value. Report the actual observed results for both steps. Do not create files, use accounts, submit other forms or change real business data.
